instruction: The italicized text in this document is hard to distinguish. I'd like to change the color of all italicized words to red to make them more noticeable. Can you apply red color (RGB 255,0,0) to all italic text?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
